defects: Conclusion uses Module.rank (cardinal-valued dimension) instead of finrank (ℕ-valued Module.finrank) as in gold; rank equality is strictly stronger than finrank equality (finrank = rank.toNat), so the two conclusions are not equivalent — rank equality implies finrank equality but not conversely (e.g. two distinct infinite ranks would give finrank equality without rank equality)

Adds hypothesis [Field S] that is not present in, nor implied by, gold's hypotheses (gold only assumes CommRing S together with IsLocalization p S / IsFractionRing R S, without requiring R to be a domain); IsFractionRing R S does not force S to be a field when R has zero divisors (e.g. R = ℤ/6ℤ, where the nonzerodivisors are units and the localization is isomorphic to R itself, not a field), so this is a strictly stronger/added hypothesis restricting generality
